equity_source_rule.context: fx futures exist from June 2011 only. STOXX50E from EA-EMPD passed bridge checks 1-2 and failed checks 3-4 on generation data.
equity_source_rule.rationale: Euro Stoxx futures exist only from June 2011, so an aligned equity coordinate is unavailable for most of the confirmation sample. The bridge passed checks 1-2 and failed 3-4, so fx and STOXX50E are not interchangeable; a single homogeneous external coordinate across 2000-2012 keeps the estimand constant within the confirmation sample rather than switching source mid-sample.

pc_normal_pre_support.context: The v1 generation build and the bridge use PC pre endpoints -25..-5, i.e. support (-30,-5]. The plan prose said (-25,-5].
pc_normal_pre_support.rationale: The v1 generation build and the bridge were computed on the -25..-5 endpoint grid. Keeping it makes the confirmation pre-PC support identical to the one the bridge validated; the plan prose said (-25,-5] but no result rests on that reading.

secondary_family_rule.context: The finite secondary list lives in the specification; the sufficiency interval is one joint history block, reported as an interval and not as a claim.
secondary_family_rule.rationale: The secondary tests are fixed in the specification before the freeze and the finite-history block enters as one joint test, reported as an interval with its calibrated floor. This prevents the sufficiency question from being restated as a claim after seeing the estimate.

slow_state_rule.context: v1 slow5 averaged full-day RV of the five previous selected contract-days, including event days and hence their post-announcement outcomes.
slow_state_rule.rationale: The v1 slow5 averages full-day RV over the five previous selected contract-days including meeting days, so on the confirmation sample it would read event post-announcement outcomes before the freeze. Event days are therefore excluded; the difference between the two rules is measured on generation data only.

us_calendar_status.context: A Thursday 08:30 New York candidate screen is not a verified release calendar.
us_calendar_status.rationale: No verified BLS/DoL release calendar has been assembled, so a Thursday 08:30 New York screen identifies candidates only. Weekday matching in the counterfactual absorbs the average exposure; the US sensitivity is reported as a candidate screen and not as a verified exclusion.
